inputs.text: In Hyderabad, BRS Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) accused the Congress government on Sunday, March 29, of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. He alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved in illegal mining. The account says the Sircilla MLA questioned something, but cuts off before specifying what.
